lines.t: A bitter wind, it's sweeping through
The love we had, the things we knew
Every kindness starts to break
Oh, look at the mess they make
They're running fast, a scheme at night
Hide, hide away from the light
But you see it all
The love of a man has lost its heat
It's freezing cold on every street
We're just captives, captives to the dark
Running on empty without a spark
The heart of a man has turned to stone
And we are so alone
They rob the poor
They lock the door
Always wanting more and more
They applaud the pain, they love the night Walking away from what is right
And every evening, when they lie down A shadow falls across this town
But judgment is near
The love of man has lost its heat
It's freezing cold on every street
We're just captives, captives to the dark
Running on empty without a spark
The heart of man has turned to stone
And we are so alone
The King is coming, look at the sky
Lift your eyes, don't just pass by
Captives, captives before the dawn
Thank you.
